scene.ko: 1교시 전에 외국인 학생에게 학교를 구경시켜 주며 실내화와 신발장, 보건실, 교무실을 소개한다.

lines.en: Let me show you around the school before first period.
alt: Before first period, I'll give you a quick tour.
Let's look around the school before class starts.

lines.en: Okay. Um, why is everyone wearing slippers?
lines.ko: 네. 음, 그런데 왜 다들 슬리퍼를 신고 있어요?

lines.en: Those are indoor shoes. In Korean schools, we change our shoes at the entrance. This is your shoe locker.
lines.ko: 그건 실내화야. 한국 학교에서는 현관에서 신발을 갈아 신어. 여기가 네 신발장이야.
alt: They're indoor shoes. In Korea, we change shoes when we come into the school. Here's your shoe locker.

lines.en: Oh, I didn't bring any. Is that a problem?
lines.ko: 아, 저 실내화 안 가져왔어요. 괜찮아요?

lines.en: No problem. I have a spare pair you can borrow today.
lines.ko: 괜찮아. 오늘은 선생님한테 있는 여분 실내화를 빌려줄게.
alt: Don't worry. You can borrow my spare pair today.

lines.en: Thank you. What's that room over there?
That's the nurse's office. If you feel sick, you can go there anytime. Just tell your teacher first.
lines.ko: 거긴 보건실이야. 몸이 안 좋으면 언제든 가도 돼. 수업 선생님한테 먼저 말만 하면 돼.
alt: It's the nurse's office. If you don't feel well, go there. Just let your teacher know first.

lines.en: Got it. And where's the teachers' room?
It's right next door. If you need anything, come find me.
lines.ko: 바로 그 옆이야. 필요한 거 있으면 거기로 선생님 찾아와.
alt: It's right next to it. Come and find me there if you need help.

expressions.note: 실내화 = indoor shoes · 신발장 = shoe locker

expressions.en: I have a spare ___ you can borrow.
If you need anything, come find me.
